evidence_used: Object is a 1000 mL hand sanitizer pump bottle with smooth, flat, parallel-ish plastic sidewalls suitable for gecko pads.
Surface is clean, glossy, and nonporous, providing optimal conditions for mushroom-tipped gecko-inspired dry-adhesive pads.
Visual scale suggests a moderate object mass (approx 1.0 kg when full), requiring modest normal pre-load to leverage high dry adhesion.
calculation_summary: Force estimated via visual approximation based on object volume/weight scale and high surface compatibility. F_normal = Baseline_load + Estimated_payload_scaling = 0.5 N + 0.7 N = 1.2 N.
assumptions_and_uncertainty: Exact mass is unmeasured and visually estimated at approximately 1 kg based on the 1000 mL volume label.
Sidewalls are assumed sufficiently flat and rigid to engage the rigid 4.2-inch gecko pads effectively.
Visual approximation introduces uncertainty regarding exact friction and adhesion coefficients.
reasoning_trace: The hand sanitizer bottle presents a smooth, clean, hard plastic exterior which is ideal for gecko-inspired dry adhesives. The parallel sidewalls allow proper engagement with the rigid gecko pads, promoting high adhesion. Since high adhesion reduces the required grip force to lift the object, a relatively low normal force of 1.2 N is estimated to securely hold the object against gravity without slipping or crushing.
